subject.title: fix(memory): search by filenames and paths

question: Should the two path-FTS trigger lifecycle helpers remain permanent public plugin SDK API, or should publication own those mechanics behind a narrower memory-host operation?
rationale: The runtime fix is valid, but repository policy treats plugin SDK expansion as compatibility-sensitive, and code inspection cannot establish whether third-party plugins are intended to manage these low-level trigger operations.

options.title: Narrow the SDK boundary
options.body: Expose one higher-level publication or path-index lifecycle operation and keep trigger drop and recreation mechanics internal to the memory host.

options.title: Keep the public helpers
options.body: Accept the three-export expansion as a supported plugin contract and require focused compatibility documentation and upgrade proof.

options.title: Pause for API design
options.body: Keep the PR open until the long-term SDK ownership boundary is agreed before shipping the migration.

recommendation.title: Narrow the SDK boundary
recommendation.body: Expose one higher-level publication or path-index lifecycle operation and keep trigger drop and recreation mechanics internal to the memory host.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the current replacement branch and has substantial history on the central files, making them the best available routing candidate for the public-boundary decision.
